subject: Post-discovery: schedule deep technical walkthrough and ops handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@northline.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@northline.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. The execs and infra team here at Northline want a focused technical walkthrough to validate latency/cost assumptions and to cover our SSO/data retention needs before we lock the procurement timeline.

High level ask: 60–75 minute session with architecture team + product to go through:
- deployment modes (hosted vs private) and networking requirements
- expected p99 latency and batching behavior for our traffic profile
- security/compliance touchpoints (SOC2, audit logs, KMS)

Availability windows next week (PST):
- Tue Dec 7: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Dec 8: 09:00–11:00

Can you propose engineers to join and any pre-read we should review? We may also ask our security lead to join (Tom will loop them in).

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Sr. Product Ops, Northline Systems
attachments: Northline_initial_scope.pdf (see note)

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Samira — great to hear the discovery was useful. Thanks for the clear agenda.

I can run the session and will bring Ben (pre-sales engineer) and Karthik (solutions infra) to cover serving topology and networking. Attached is a short agenda and proposed prep notes.

Proposed slots (all PST) — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom:
- Tue Dec 7 10:30–11:45 (best for engineering deep-dive + Q/A)
- Tue Dec 7 15:00–16:15 (good if execs prefer afternoon)
- Wed Dec 8 09:30–10:45 (morning slot; we can tighten to 60 minutes)

Pre-read: I’m attaching a 1-page outline (redwood-prelim-arch-agenda.pdf) that maps to your bullets. If Tom or your security lead can share a one-pager on specific compliance questions we’ll make sure to cover them in the runbook.

Notes for internal team: Ben/Karthik, please confirm if you can take Tue 10:30 or Wed 09:30 — Ben I expect you to walk the serving runtime + batching slides; Karthik, please prepare a short network diagram showing VPC peering options and required egress rules.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-prelim-arch-agenda.pdf

- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (we will update with passcode in calendar invite)
